display.name: Monthly cost by team, namespace and workload
display.description: OpenCost-style allocation × node prices, 730 hours a month. Click a box to open it; namespaces without a team label are under (none).

spec.query: sum by (team, namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(((sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_cpu_allocation) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost) + sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_allocation_bytes) / 1073741824 * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_ram_hourly_cost)) * 730) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app) kube_pod_labels * on (namespace) group_left (label_team) kube_namespace_labels, "team", "$1", "label_team", "(.*)"), "workload", "$1", "label_app", "(.*)"))

display.name: Monthly cost of every pod (2,000 leaves)
display.description: Four levels, no topN: every pod is a box. Small boxes show their name and value on hover.

spec.query: sum by (team, namespace, workload, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(((sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_cpu_allocation) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost) + sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_allocation_bytes) / 1073741824 * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_ram_hourly_cost)) * 730) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app) kube_pod_labels * on (namespace) group_left (label_team) kube_namespace_labels, "team", "$1", "label_team", "(.*)"), "workload", "$1", "label_app", "(.*)"))

display.name: Memory allocated by namespace and workload
display.description: Coloured by share of the total: amber at 5%, red at 10%. The 5 largest per parent, the rest in Other. No breadcrumb: an Up button appears after drilling in.

spec.query: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_allocation_bytes) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app) kube_pod_labels, "workload", "$1", "label_app", "(.*)"))
